title: Wrong approach — using a ternary instead
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ name: payload.name, phone: if (payload.phone != "") payload.phone else null, title: if (payload.title != "") payload.title else null }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ name: payload.name, phone: if (payload.phone != "") payload.phone else null, title: if (payload.title != "") payload.title else null }

explanation.approach: This creates a null value when the condition fails. The field still appears in the output with a null value — exactly what the problem asked you NOT to do. The conditional field syntax `(key: value) if (...)` omits the entire field instead.
